findings.quote: Her digs showed the soil further down to be bare of living root.
findings.note: ARGUABLE. The prompt carries no scope limiter ('mainly', 'chiefly'), so any true finding of hers competes with the key. Counsel: paragraph 2 reports that half a metre down 'there was almost nothing alive: the soil was dry, airless, nearly impenetrable', and then, flatly, 'The roots were somewhere else' - read together that is a finding that the deeper soil held no living root. It dies on one hedge: 'almost nothing alive' concedes that something was alive, and 'The roots were somewhere else' is a contrast about where the mats sat rather than a census, while the conclusion the paragraph builds to is the key's - 'Most of the force, we think, is generated within a hand's width of the stone.' Beatable, but the entire defence rests on the single word 'almost', which is thinner than anything else on these three sheets.

findings.quote: Their roots appear to have moved down into the loose loam below.
findings.note: CLEAN (rebuilt option, attacked hard). Counsel can run the mechanism argument - the cells 'move the damp, aired horizon down and away from the stones' and 'On twenty-five streets the celled flags have stayed within tolerance' - but paragraph 5 exists to refuse exactly that inference: 'The surveys measure the stones, and only the stones', 'We are reading the flags, not the roots', 'For all we know, the bedding on the good streets is filling with root that has not yet found its strength', and 'on the twenty-five it is not' won. The paragraph that kills this option is the paragraph that hands the reader the key.

findings.quote: The gauge readings taken on them have been falling year by year.
findings.note: CLEAN (rebuilt option). The passage supplies the opposite datum twice: the twenty-five 'have stayed within tolerance' (stable, not improving) and on the oldest celled pavement 'the wedge gauge showed four millimetres, the same figure as the year before'.

findings.quote: She thinks the results bore him out on the whole, with a few exceptions.
findings.note: CLEAN (rebuilt two-sided option). It inverts the trial's proportions: Fearnbeck was borne out on five streets and not on twenty-five - 'On the five streets the case is fairly won; on the twenty-five it is not' - so 'on the whole' points the wrong way. Attractive only to a reader who registers that both sides scored without counting.

findings.quote: Why old trees lift the paving above them, and why the remedies keep failing.
findings.note: CLEAN, and the specific claim was verified: the remedies do not keep failing. The 'Each measure buys a season or two. The flags keep rising' framing belongs to paragraph 1's traditional remedies only; the trial that occupies paragraphs 3-5 reports 'On twenty-five streets the celled flags have stayed within tolerance while the ordinary sides opposite have been ground level twice and relaid once', with the oldest celled pavement stable at four millimetres in its eighth year. Five of thirty-one failed and 'have since been relaid'. Askerholt's closing hedge is epistemic - 'The stones are behaving; that is all I will sign my name to' - not a report of failure, so the option's second clause is contradicted by the body of the text, while the key's neutral 'how one city's remedy has fared' covers both halves of the piece.

findings.quote: Den släckta massan lades i gropar för att mogna.
findings.note: CLEAN (rebuilt world-plausible option; the timing flip checked against section 3). True of lime-putty practice in general, but the prompt is 'enligt texten' and section 3 states the opposite sequence: what is stored is the unslaked stone - 'den brända stenen förvarades torr till dess den skulle släckas och blandas till bruk' - dry and before slaking. No pit and no maturation stage appears anywhere in the passage.

findings.quote: Kalken blandades med sand medan den ännu sjöd.
findings.note: CLEAN (rebuilt world-plausible option). Hot-mixing is real practice, but the text fixes the order: the stone seethes and falls apart to powder first, and it is that product - 'den släckta kalk som blandad med sand ger murbruk' - that meets the sand; section 3 repeats the order, 'släckas och blandas till bruk'. The simultaneity in 'medan den ännu sjöd' is the option's own addition.

findings.quote: Många bönder lade jordbruket åt sidan för kalkens skull.
findings.note: CLEAN (de-absolutised option, attacked hard). Counsel can cite 'för många hushåll var ugnen den binäring som över huvud taget gav kontanter', but the same noun defeats it: burning is a binäring, glossed in the sheet as 'sysselsättning vid sidan av jordbruket', and it was scheduled around farming - 'bränningen låg om försommaren, när vårbruket var undanstökat' - with any one kiln fired only 'vartannat eller vart tredje år'.

findings.quote: Kalken gick i första hand till åkrarna som jordförbättring.
findings.note: CLEAN (de-absolutised option). The softened 'i första hand' is refuted head-on: 'Framför allt var det dit kalken gick: till murningen av stenhus, broar och kyrktorn', with the fields getting only 'något hamnade på åkrarna som jordförbättring'.

findings.quote: Den bygger på en enda räkning av löpare.
findings.note: ARGUABLE, and the strongest counsel case in the round. The author really does attack a single count: 'som stöd redovisas ett besök i augusti då förvaltningen räknade till fyra personer på spåret efter nio', then 'Augustibesöket bevisar inte heller det som tjänsteskrivelsen låter påskina. I augusti är det ljust till halv tio'. It dies on the prompt's noun. The text reserves 'kalkyl' for the money - 'kalkylen i tjänsteskrivelsen anger en besparing på 38 000 kronor om året', 'Kalkylen utgår ändå från de gamla lamporna', 'låt nästa kalkyl utgå från de lampor som sitter uppe i dag' - whereas the August visit is offered as stöd for the separate claim that the change is 'begränsat för flertalet motionärer'. A headcount is not an input to a kronor calculation, so the option's 'Den' (= kalkylen) is false. Discrimination rests wholly on the reader binding 'kalkyl' to the 38 000-figure; adjudication may want the stem tightened (e.g. 'besparingskalkyl').
